our_interpretation: In the surrounding discussion of generated pictures, the ordinary reading is that ChatGPT still makes elementary biological or anatomical errors in images.
Struggles means a demonstrable recurring difficulty, without implying that every output fails or that performance has not improved.
The ongoing observation is assessed for August 2025 through publication on August 27. This is the latest contemporaneous observation period; the post specifies no reporting period.

Relevant tasks include depicting or labeling familiar body parts and following simple anatomical part-count instructions. Failure to draw an intentionally unusual animal would establish an instruction-following problem, not necessarily ignorance of normal biology.
criteria.support_condition: Dated, independently inspectable ChatGPT outputs from the target period show repeated elementary anatomical, biological, or body-part errors on clear image-generation prompts.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Representative contemporaneous testing of the relevant elementary tasks shows reliable success and establishes that the alleged errors were misattributed, misinterpreted, or no longer characteristic of the available system.
